answer: A bond is refunded only after 35 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. The ripple counter is kept in quartz and yarrow makes public each reset. Anyone therefore has to keep every sock puppet continuously active for 35 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. Each duplicate costs another 64 dollars in locked collateral and another 11 days of waiting. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
